description: Agent generates .mmd diagram files in arch/ directory during plan workflow
steps: Run /vista:plan for a new feature
Reach Step 5 (architecture generation)
Verify arch/ directory created with .mmd files (system-arch.mmd, user-flow.mmd, sequence.mmd, etc.)
Verify _arch.json manifest written with correct entries for each file
Verify _plan.json includes architecture.ref pointing to ./arch/_arch.json

description: setup-feature.py scaffolds arch/ directory and empty _arch.json
steps: Run python vista/scripts/setup-feature.py --name test-feature
Verify .vista/features/test-feature/arch/ directory exists
Verify .vista/features/test-feature/arch/_arch.json exists with empty diagrams array
Verify existing scaffolded files (domain-requirements.md, specs/, progress.txt) still created

description: _arch.json manifest validates against schema with correct structure
steps: Create _arch.json with feature name and diagrams array
Each diagram entry has: name, file, type (mermaid|drawio), diagramType, description
Verify manifest validates successfully
Verify invalid manifest (missing required fields) is rejected by server

description: Plan JSON schema no longer requires uiFlows, dataModels, dataFlow, services sections
steps: Create a _plan.json with only meta, implementationPhases, and architecture.ref
Validate against updated plan-schema.json
Verify validation passes without uiFlows, dataModels, dataFlow, services
Verify architecture.ref field is accepted

description: Web app loads and displays diagram manifest from API
steps: Navigate to /project/{id}/arch/{feature_name}
Verify page makes GET /api/projects/{id}/features/{name}/arch request
Verify manifest data returned with diagram entries
Verify each diagram entry renders as a card with title and description

description: Mermaid .mmd files render as interactive SVG in browser
steps: Create a valid .mmd file with flowchart syntax in arch/
Register it in _arch.json as type 'mermaid'
Open the feature architecture page in browser
Verify mermaid.js renders the .mmd content as SVG within the diagram card
Verify the rendered diagram is interactive (zoomable/pannable)

description: Draw.io .drawio files render in embedded viewer
steps: Create a valid .drawio XML file in arch/
Register it in _arch.json as type 'drawio'
Open the feature architecture page in browser
Verify Draw.io viewer iframe loads with the file content
Verify the diagram is viewable and navigable

description: Multiple diagram types render on the same page
steps: Create arch/ with 3 .mmd files and 1 .drawio file
Register all in _arch.json
Open the feature architecture page
Verify all 4 diagrams render correctly in separate cards
Verify each card shows correct title, description, and rendered content

description: Chat panel opens with Notion-style slide-out from bottom-right button
steps: Open the feature architecture page
Verify floating button visible in bottom-right corner
Click the button
Verify chat panel slides out from right
Verify page reflows to side-by-side layout (diagrams ~60%, chat ~40%)
Click button again to verify panel closes and layout restores

description: Provider and model dropdowns populate from existing API
steps: Open chat panel
Verify provider dropdown loads options from GET /api/providers
Select a provider (e.g., Claude Code)
Verify model dropdown populates from GET /api/providers/claude/models
Verify models list shows (e.g., opus, sonnet, haiku)

description: Clicking a diagram attaches it as context chip in chat input
steps: Open chat panel
Click on a rendered mermaid diagram
Verify diagram appears as a chip/tag in the message input area
Verify chip shows the diagram name from manifest
Verify chip is removable by clicking X
Click a second diagram to verify multiple attachments work

description: Sending a chat message invokes CLI and streams response
steps: Open chat panel, select provider and model
Attach a diagram and type a message
Click send
Verify POST /api/chat/send called with provider, model, message, and diagram content
Verify server invokes the CLI with the prompt
Verify response streams back via SSE token-by-token
Verify AI response renders as markdown in chat thread

description: Chat thread displays message history with correct alignment
steps: Send 3 messages in chat and receive 3 responses
Verify user messages appear right-aligned
Verify AI responses appear left-aligned
Verify messages are in chronological order
Verify chat auto-scrolls to latest message

description: Server API serves individual diagram file contents
steps: Create arch/ with a .mmd file
GET /api/projects/{id}/features/{name}/arch/system-arch.mmd
Verify raw Mermaid text content returned
Verify Content-Type is text/plain
GET with .drawio filename returns XML content

description: Mermaid parse error displays inline with raw source
steps: Create a .mmd file with invalid Mermaid syntax
Register in _arch.json
Open architecture page
Verify error message displayed in the diagram card
Verify raw Mermaid source is visible for debugging

description: Missing diagram file shows placeholder in card
steps: Register a diagram in _arch.json pointing to a non-existent file
Open architecture page
Verify placeholder message ('File not found') displayed in card
Verify other diagrams still render normally (error boundary per card)

description: Malformed _arch.json returns validation error from server
steps: Write _arch.json with missing required fields (e.g., no 'type' on a diagram entry)
GET /api/projects/{id}/features/{name}/arch
Verify server returns 400 with validation error message
Verify error describes which field is missing

description: No providers configured disables chat send button
steps: Configure settings with no enabled providers
Open chat panel
Verify provider dropdown shows 'No providers configured'
Verify send button is disabled
Verify helpful message displayed in chat area

description: CLI invocation failure shows error in chat thread
steps: Select a provider and model, send a message
Simulate CLI process failure (exit code non-zero)
Verify error message displayed as system message in chat thread
Verify user can send another message after the error

description: SSE connection drop shows reconnecting indicator and recovers
steps: Start a chat conversation with streaming response
Simulate SSE connection drop mid-stream
Verify 'Reconnecting...' indicator shown in chat
Verify connection auto-reconnects
Verify user can send new messages after reconnection

description: Feature with no arch/ directory shows empty state
steps: Navigate to architecture page for a feature that has no arch/ directory
Verify page shows 'No architecture diagrams found' message
Verify instructions or link to run /vista:plan shown

description: Mermaid diagram renders in under 1 second
steps: Create a moderately complex .mmd file (20+ nodes)
Open architecture page and measure render time
Verify diagram appears within 1 second of page load

description: Page with 5 diagrams loads in under 3 seconds total
steps: Create arch/ with 5 .mmd files of moderate complexity
Open architecture page and measure total load time
Verify all 5 diagrams rendered within 3 seconds

description: First AI response token visible within 2 seconds of sending
steps: Open chat, select provider/model, type a short message
Click send and start timer
Verify first token of AI response appears within 2 seconds

description: Chat panel responsive layout works at different viewport widths
steps: Open architecture page at 1920px width
Open chat panel, verify 60/40 split
Resize to 1024px, verify layout still usable
Resize to 768px, verify chat overlays diagrams (mobile-friendly)

description: Diagram cards have loading skeleton while fetching content
steps: Open architecture page
Verify each card shows loading skeleton/spinner while diagram fetches
Verify skeleton replaced by rendered diagram when complete
Verify loading states are independent per card

description: Chat message input area handles diagram attachment chips cleanly
steps: Attach 3 diagrams as chips
Verify chips wrap to multiple lines if needed
Verify text input area remains usable below chips
Remove a chip and verify layout adjusts
Verify chip displays diagram name (not filename)

description: Server only serves files from within the arch/ directory (no path traversal)
steps: GET /api/projects/{id}/features/{name}/arch/../../secrets.json
Verify server returns 400 or 404 (not file contents)
Verify path traversal is blocked
Verify only files listed in _arch.json are servable
